reviews.text: This hand cream made my skin soft and healthier. Around winter, my hands get dry and even bleed, after I started using this product, I immediately loved it. After I finish this bottle, I'm definitely ordering more. The packaging is very beautiful too.
reviews.zh: 呢款護手霜令我嘅皮膚更加柔軟、健康。每到冬天，我嘅手會乾到甚至流血，自從用咗呢款產品之後，我即刻就好鍾意。用完呢支之後，我一定會再訂。包裝都好靚。

reviews.text: I recently tried the Bouquet Garni Baby Powder Perfume Hand Cream, and it’s such a lovely everyday hand cream. The texture is lightweight and smooth, so it absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a greasy feeling. It keeps my hands feeling soft and moisturized, which is perfect especially when my hands get dry.
reviews.zh: 我最近試咗 Bouquet Garni Baby Powder Perfume Hand Cream，真係一款好好嘅日常護手霜。質地輕盈順滑，吸收快，唔會留低油膩感。令我雙手保持柔軟、滋潤，尤其係當我雙手乾燥嗰時，好啱用。

reviews.text: This hand lotion is so creamy and moisturizing. It soaks into your skin immediately, making your hands incredibly soft. The baby powder scent is such a unique and comforting smell. I can't talk highly enough about this product.
reviews.zh: 呢款護手霜好綿密、好滋潤。即刻滲入皮膚，令雙手變得好軟。嬰兒爽身粉嘅味道好獨特，又令人感到安心舒服。我真係講唔盡呢款產品有幾好。

reviews.text: I got the rose garden one and when I tell you the scent of this handcream is phenomenal!! it is like im in an actual rose garden. Not only that but after i put it on, since it has shea butter my skin became very moisturised. so i love it! would purchase again!
reviews.zh: 我買咗 rose garden 嗰款，我同你講，呢款護手霜嘅香味真係太出色了！！好似身處喺真正嘅玫瑰花園入面咁。不止咁，塗咗之後，因為佢含有乳木果脂，我嘅皮膚都好滋潤。所以我好鍾意！會再買！

reviews.text: This smells soooo good. It smells like baby powder more than clean soap. It isn't deeply moisturizing but it is so nice to use during the winter when you just need something quick to use. It is also really easy to store in your bag.
reviews.zh: 呢個味道好好聞。佢聞落似爽身粉多過潔淨肥皂。保濕力唔算深層，但係冬天用就好好，當你需要一樣快手嘅產品嗰時。亦都好易放喺袋入面。

reviews.text: I wanted a small hand cream to keep in my bag, but now I don't want to take it off my desk because the design is too cute. I bought the clean soap scent and it smells like standard bar soap, but I got the baby powder scented lotion as a promotion and oh my god. It's not something I would wear as perfume, but it gave me so much nostalgia. It smells like the laundry detergent my grandma and aunt use in Shanghai. To me, it's like fresh linens. I love it
reviews.zh: 我本來想買一支細嘅護手霜放喺袋入面，但係而家我唔捨得拎離開枱面，因為設計太可愛。我買咗清潔肥皂味，佢聞落好似普通嘅肥皂咁，但係我因為推廣而拎到爽身粉味嘅身體乳，天呀。我唔會當香水噴身，但係佢令我好懷舊。佢聞落似我阿嫲同阿姨喺上海用嘅洗衣液，對我嚟講好似曬過嘅新床單咁。我好鍾意。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
